# cidaas_notification_service_setups (Data Source)

Lists **service setups** from notification-srv `GET /{notifications_context_path}/servicesetups/` so you can reference `service_setup_id` values in `cidaas_notifications_template_group` `comm_setting_*` blocks.

**Important:** this list returns **active** setups only. Setups that are still `in-progress` (created but not yet verified in service-desk) do not appear. Use **`data.cidaas_notification_service_setup`** or the managed resource to read a single setup by id (any status).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cidaas_notification_service_setups" "all" {}

output "active_setup_ids" {
  value = [for s in data.cidaas_notification_service_setups.all.setups : s.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable datasource instance id (random UUID).
- `setups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--setups))

<a id="nestedatt--setups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `setups`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `has_remote_templates` (Boolean) Whether templates are remote.
- `id` (String) Service setup `_id` (use as `service_setup_id` in comm settings).
- `name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `parent_service_setup_id` (String) Parent setup id when applicable.
- `service_category` (String) Service category from `serviceDescInfo`.
- `service_id` (String) Service id from `serviceDescInfo`.
- `status` (String) Setup status (expected `active` for list results).
